arxiv-1401-2055.title: Approximation by Genuine q q -Bernstein-Durrmeyer Polynomials in Compact Disks in the case q > 1 q>1
arxiv-1401-2055.creator: Nazim I. Mahmudov
arxiv-1401-2055.description: Abstract This paper deals with approximating properties of the newly defined q q -generalization of the genuine Bernstein-Durrmeyer polynomials in the case q > 1 q>1 , whcih are no longer positive linear operators on C ⁡ [ 0 , 1 ] C[0,1] .

arxiv-2105-08910.title: Ab initio
arxiv-2105-08910.creator: nuclear structure via quantum adiabatic algorithm
arxiv-2105-08910.description: Abstract Abstract Background: Solving nuclear many-body problems with an ab initio approach is widely recognized as a computationally challenging problem. Quantum computers offer a promising path to address this challenge. There are urgent needs to develop quantum algorithms for this purpose.

arxiv-2111-14606.title: An Extension of the Kazhdan–Lusztig Equivalence
arxiv-2111-14606.creator: Lin Chen, Yuchen Fu
arxiv-2111-14606.description: Abstract We prove a tamely ramified version of the Kazhdan–Lusztig equivalence using factorization algebras. More precisely, we establish an equivalence between the DG category of Iwahori–integrable affine Lie algebra representations and the DG category of representations of the “mixed” quantum group. This confirms a conjecture by D. Gaitsgory in [ Gai21 ] . 1 Introduction 1.

arxiv-2310-13460.title: A Langlands duality of elliptic Hecke algebras
arxiv-2310-13460.creator: Gufang Zhao, Changlong Zhong
arxiv-2310-13460.description: Abstract . Associated to any root datum, there is an elliptic affine Hecke algebra defined by Ginzburg, Kapranov, and Vasserot. In this study, we establish a Fourier-Mukai functor from the representation category of the elliptic affine Hecke algebra to the corresponding category associated with the Langlands dual root datum.

arxiv-2402-12832.title: Nearly Optimal Fault Tolerant Distance Oracle
arxiv-2402-12832.creator: Dipan Dey, Manoj Gupta
arxiv-2402-12832.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dipan Dey, Manoj Gupta. We present an f f -fault tolerant distance oracle for an undirected weighted graph where each edge has an integral weight from [ 1 ​ … ​ W ] [1\dots W] .

arxiv-2405-20108.title: Complete characterization of symmetric Kubo-Ando operator means satisfying Molnár’s weak associativity
arxiv-2405-20108.creator: Yury Grabovsky
arxiv-2405-20108.description: Abstract We provide a complete characterization of a subclass of weakly associative means of positive operators in the class of symmetric Kubo-Ando means. This class, which includes the geometric mean, was first introduced and studied in L. Molnár, Characterizations of certain means of positive operators , Linear Algebra Appl.

arxiv-2501-10216.title: The Relevance of AWS Chronos: An Evaluation of Standard Methods for Time Series Forecasting with Limited Tuning
arxiv-2501-10216.creator: Matthew Baron \sthanks matthew.baron@nike.com, Alex Karpinski \sthanks alexkarp@umd.edu
arxiv-2501-10216.description: Abstract A systematic comparison of Chronos, a transformer-based time series forecasting framework, against traditional approaches including ARIMA and Prophet. We evaluate these models across multiple time horizons and user categories, with a focus on the impact of historical context length.

arxiv-2501-17464.title: Modelling a storage system of a wind farm with a ramp-rate limitation: a semi-Markov modulated Brownian bridge approach
arxiv-2501-17464.creator: Abel Azze, Guglielmo D’Amico, Bernardo D’Auria, Salvatore Vergine
arxiv-2501-17464.description: Abstract We propose a new methodology to simulate the discounted penalty applied to a wind-farm operator by violating ramp-rate limitation policies. It is assumed that the operator manages a wind turbine plugged into a battery, which either provides or stores energy on demand to avoid ramp-up and ramp-down events.

arxiv-2509-04482.title: Energy Landscapes Enable Reliable Abstention in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Healthcare
arxiv-2509-04482.creator: Ravi Shankar, Sheng Wong, Lin Li, Magdalena Bachmann, Alex Silverthorne, Beth Albert, Gabriel Davis Jones
arxiv-2509-04482.description: Abstract Reliable abstention is critical for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, particularly in safety-critical domains such as women’s health, where incorrect answers can lead to harm. We present an energy-based model (EBM) that learns a smooth energy landscape over a dense semantic corpus of 2.6M guideline-derived questions, enabling the system to decide when to generate or abstain.

arxiv-2512-19303.title: Simple cubic variance functions in ℝ n , \mathbb{R}^{n}, Part one
arxiv-2512-19303.creator: Abdelhamid Hassairi, Gérard Letac
arxiv-2512-19303.description: Abstract The classification of natural exponential families started with the paper [ 15 ] where Carl Morris unifies six very familiar families by the fact that their variance functions are polynomials of degree less or equal to two. Extension of this classification to ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} and to degree three is the subject of this paper.

arxiv-2601-11182.title: From Knots to Knobs: Towards Steerable Collaborative Filtering Using Sparse Autoencoders CCS: Information systems Recommender systems
arxiv-2601-11182.creator: Martin Spišák, Ladislav Peška, Petr Škoda, Vojtěch Vančura, Rodrigo Alves
arxiv-2601-11182.description: Abstract . Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have recently emerged as pivotal tools for introspection into large language models. SAEs can uncover high-quality, interpretable features at different levels of granularity and enable targeted steering of the generation process by selectively activating specific neurons in their latent activations.

pmc-10571881.title: The Expression of Amino Acid and Fatty Acid Receptors Show an Age-Dependent Pattern Involving Oral Cavity, Jejunum and Lower Gut Sensing in Broiler Chickens
pmc-10571881.creator: Paloma Cordero, Francisca Díaz-Avilés, Paulina Torres, Miguel Guzmán, Shahram Niknafs, Eugeni Roura, Sergio A. Guzmán-Pino
pmc-10571881.description: Simple SummaryThere is limited information regarding dietary nutrient sensors in chickens. This study explored the expression of amino acid (AA) and fatty acid (FA) sensors in the gastrointestinal tract (GIT) of broilers. This research focused on quantifying gene expression of AA and FA sensors in ten tissues, including the upper, middle, and lower GIT sections of 7 and 26-day-old birds.

pmc-11360570.title: Research Progress on Saccharide Molecule Detection Based on Nanopores
pmc-11360570.creator: Bohua Yin, Wanyi Xie, Shaoxi Fang, Shixuan He, Wenhao Ma, Liyuan Liang, Yajie Yin, Daming Zhou, Zuobin Wang, Deqiang Wang
pmc-11360570.description: Saccharides, being one of the fundamental molecules of life, play essential roles in the physiological and pathological functions of cells. However, their intricate structures pose challenges for detection. Nanopore technology, with its high sensitivity and capability for single-molecule-level analysis, has revolutionized the identification and structural analysis of saccharide molecules.

pmc-11531422.title: High SHBG and Low Bioavailable Testosterone are Strongly Causally Associated with Increased Forearm Fracture Risk in Women: An MR Study Leveraging Novel Female-Specific Data
pmc-11531422.creator: Johan Quester, Maria Nethander, Eivind Coward, Ene Reimann, Reedik Mägi, Andres Metspalu, Andres Metspalu, Lili Milani, Tõnu Esko, Reedik Mägi, Mari Nelis, Georgi Hudjashov, Ulrika Pettersson-Kymmer, Kristian Hveem, Claes Ohlsson
pmc-11531422.description: The effects of androgens on women’s bone health are not fully understood. Mendelian randomization (MR) studies using sex-combined data suggest that sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) and bioavailable testosterone (BioT) causally affect bone traits. Given significant sex differences in hormone regulation and effects, female-specific MR studies are necessary.

pmc-11770993.title: Exploring the association between caffeine intake and benign prostatic hyperplasia: results from the NHANES 2005–2008
pmc-11770993.creator: Fei Zhang, Andong Zhang, Junyue Tao, Meng Zhang, Chaozhao Liang
pmc-11770993.description: BackgroundCoffee is a physiologically active food component prevalent throughout the world, but the association between caffeine intake and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) has been limited in extensive epidemiological studies.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study to evaluate the association between caffeine intake and BPH in adults in the United States using data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2005–2008.

pmc-12469841.title: Distinct Adipocyte Responses to Δ9-Tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) Exposure Govern Hepatic Lipid Accumulation in an Obesogenic Setting
pmc-12469841.creator: Adi Eitan, Ofer Gover, Betty Schwartz
pmc-12469841.description: The effects of Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) on adipocyte function under obesogenic, free-fatty-acid (FFA)-rich conditions remain poorly characterized, particularly regarding adipogenesis, FFA buffering, and downstream hepatocyte lipid handling. We investigated THC’s effect on adipogenic differentiation, temporal FFA buffering in mature adipocytes under lipid stress, and hepatocyte lipid accumulation driven by extracellular FFAs. The 3T3-L1 preadipocytes were differentiated in 0.

pmc-12528386.creator: Matylda Zietek, Amanda Miguel, Handuo Shi, Iskander Khusainov, Abir T Asmar, Sri Ram, Morgane Wartel, Anna Sueki, Martin Schorb, Mark Goulian, Jean-François Collet, Martin Beck, Kerwyn Casey Huang, Athanasios Typas

In Escherichia coli, the Rcs system is required to survive treatment with A22 and mecillinam, antibiotics that perturb cell size. To test whether size changes are correlated with envelope damage and thereby sensed by the Rcs system, we tuned E.

pmc-12530372.title: Leak during term neonatal CPAP stabilisation: does resuscitation device design affect delivered PEEP – a bench study
pmc-12530372.creator: Viktoria Gruber, Stephanie Morakeas, Murray Hinder, Thomas Drevhammar, Mithilesh Dronavalli, Mark Brian Tracy
pmc-12530372.description: BackgroundMask leak is common during newborn resuscitation, impacting delivered ventilation. Less is known about the effect of leak during assisted spontaneous breathing with continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP).AimCompare CPAP performance in the presence of leak of two T-piece resuscitation devices, with differing design-imposed resistances: high resistance Neopuff and low resistance rPAP.

pmc-12715490.title: Three-Dimensional Imaging of Human Myocardial Collagen Fibers Using Trypan Blue Staining
pmc-12715490.creator: A.A. Beketova, O.V. Kirik, D.E. Korzhevskii
pmc-12715490.description: The aim of the study was to estimate the availability of trypan blue staining of human myocardium sections to investigate cardiac collagen fibers, in particular, their three-dimensional reconstructions.Materials and MethodsPretreated with phosphomolybdic acid sections of human myocardium (n=9) were stained with 1% aqueous trypan blue solution (Panreac, Spain) (patent application RU 2024/22564).

pmc-13259243.title: A Hierarchical Sensor Data Fusion and Roving Sensor Network Framework for Structural Health Monitoring: Application to Bridge Retrofitting
pmc-13259243.creator: Emrullah Dar, Tarık Tufan, Selahattin Akalp, Ferit Yardımcı
pmc-13259243.description: Extracting reliable damage-sensitive features from sparse sensor networks under Environmental and Operational Variations (EOV) remains a critical challenge in Structural Health Monitoring (SHM). The purpose of this study is to overcome this limitation by proposing a novel, data-driven framework utilizing a cost-effective network of high-sensitivity triaxial roving accelerometers.

pmc-13495667.creator: Avni S. Patel, Maija J. Raudsepp, Jean-Michel Brazier, Anna L. Harrison, Sasha Wilson

pmc-13512508.title: Preparation of Eggshell–Sodium Alginate/Polyvinyl Alcohol Composite Hydrogel Carrier-Embedded Rhizobacteria and Their Storage Properties
pmc-13512508.creator: Yanjun Cui, Yongsheng Xiang, Libo Jiang, Shuxia Fang, Aolei He, Tuo Yao, Bing Hu, Jia Wei
pmc-13512508.description: Rhizobial inoculants play a critical role in sustainable agriculture by enhancing biological nitrogen fixation; however, maintaining rhizobial viability during storage remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, six embedded rhizobial formulations, designated E-SA/PVA R1 through E-SA/PVA R6, were prepared via an embedding method using sodium alginate (SA), polyvinyl alcohol (PVA), and eggshell powder as primary materials with varying component ratios.

pmc-13557543.title: Effects and Mechanisms of Action of Acupuncture on Bone and Lipid Metabolism in a Rat Model of Postmenopausal Osteoporosis
pmc-13557543.creator: Sheng-Nan ZHANG, Chu-Chu ZHANG, Li-Hua JIANG, Gang OUYANG
pmc-13557543.description: SummaryThis study investigated the effects of acupuncture on bone and lipid metabolism in a rat model of postmenopausal osteoporosis (PMOP). Thirty-two female Sprague-Dawley rats were randomly assigned to four groups: blank control, sham-operated, model (ovariectomy), and acupuncture treatment (ovariectomy plus acupuncture).

pmc-13610756.title: Assessment of antimicrobial use among patients admitted to a tertiary care hospital: A prospective observational study using World Health Organization AWaRe and Indian Council of Medical Research guidelines
pmc-13610756.creator: Ankur, Prem Kapur, Neetu Shree, Rajiv Chhabra, Kiran Dubey
pmc-13610756.description: BACKGROUND:Antimicrobial resistance has emerged as a global challenge to human health, primarily due to inappropriate use. The ICMR reports revealed that there is sustained rise of AMR in India.OBJECTIVE:The objective of this study was to evaluate the prescribing pattern of antimicrobials and rationality of empiric antimicrobial use in a tertiary care hospital.
